notes.title: ☄️Appulse new demo is out☄️
notes.notes:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558110/Appulse/"][/dynamiclink]Hello everyone !

For the past two months, we have been focused on improving the core gameplay of the game. The feedback gathered thanks to the last demo in May helped us a lot!  [/p][p]Among all the changes we made, the camera system has been reworked, physics has been improved, and the cores no longer destroy pinball mechanisms. We have also crafted a [b]brand-new spaceship[/b] that we hope you will love! [/p][p][/p][p]A lot of new content is on the way including meta progression, shuttle attacks and more![/p][p] [/p][p][i]Here is a sneak peek at the new demo[/i] 👇 [/p][previewyoutube="EJRIjLR80Hw;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/521317dec74d308bd59db81451f82493b38dad54.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/5510bf9760c82bff8fdb4136f38bfed49fba54f2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/10ad8b221ef6fd7df70372cd91fd9db00da10e59.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/c6b891cbecad05b0cc04b2af98db0d5bda760fa8.jpg"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]We are proud to announce this demo is part of [b]Tiny Teams festival[/b] and [b]Busan Indie Connect[/b]. Two great events that will put a spotlight on Appulse. [/p][p][/p][p]There are many other amazing games featured, you should take a look at them:[/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff002d"]Tiny Teams Steam Page[/url]  [/b]  [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/31736249/sale/bic2025" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff002d"]Busan Indie Connect Steam Page[/url][/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/433ca78d341e6f36c965027fe5e654ac7e39293a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As always, feel free to share your opinions about the demo with us, it helps us a lot! [/p][p][b]Thank you for your support! ❤️‍🔥[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558110/Appulse/"][/dynamiclink] [/p]

notes.title: ☄️ Appulse Demo Ending ☄️
notes.notes:
[h3] 🚀 The current Appulse free demo trial is now over ! 🚀 [/h3][p][/p][p]We gathered of lot of feedback during the time our demo was up. It was very interesting to hear what gamers had to say to our concept, and we are currently actively working on the main issues, such as the frustration to lose your flippers. We are already improving gameplay by adding healing abilities and a better onboarding.[/p][p][/p][p]Therefore, we would like to give huge thanks to all the people who participated to our event and to the AG French Direct who featured us. We really hope you liked what you discovered in Appulse, and that you want more! [/p][p][/p][p][b]We are cooking brand new mechanics, featuring meta progression and new boards so watch out for any news from us, we may release a new demo in the upcoming month 🔥 [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/dde787c50039b90d99bd80921d1351a931bf75eb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]If you missed the AG French Direct stream, you can watch the replay here to see our new teaser :[/b][/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="_mJfGPdssCU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][h2]🌟 Wishlist it now to sail the stars with us!🌟 [/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498700/Appulse"][/dynamiclink] [/p][h2]☄️ Coming end of 2025 ☄️[/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="j5pjDsfEOuk;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: ☄️ Appulse Demo now available ☄️
notes.notes:
[h3] 🚀 The time has finally come, the demo of Appulse is out now! 🚀 [/h3]

Appulse is currently featured in the AG French Direct, a special event focused on upcoming french games, where our new demo has been revealed.

We are excited to show a new version of our game, with refined visuals, improved gameplay, new perks and new enemies.

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/0fdd3ec9950436a4dd34d31cd344101e19247237.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
Download the demo now, embark on your spaceship and beat all waves of enemies.
Will you be up to the challenge?

[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/36828514148069edf579fc7b01d6b16effb4b090.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
We can't wait to hear your feedback to better shape the future of Appulse. We really look forward to continue this epic journey, and show you everything we have prepared for the full game.

[hr][/hr]
